brief: Explain the fictional service’s repair and trade-in options without invented savings or turnaround promises.
result: Present two paths: repair assessment for a device the customer wants to keep, or a trade-in assessment when replacement is being considered. Show the quote and conditions before asking the customer to choose.
rationale: The two-path explanation makes the offer easier to compare. EPA guidance informs the data-preparation reminder; it does not validate prices, repair outcomes or trade-in values.
considerations: Use only confirmed service terms. Keep backup and personal-data preparation visible before device handover.

sources.title: EPA: Electronics Donation and Recycling
sources.statement: EPA guidance recommends deleting personal information before donating or recycling electronics and handling batteries separately when appropriate.
